sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 2x Radios, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras, 1x Camera Charger.
Morning shift deployed. Ops phone at 5%; guards on standby while charging, available for response calls.
Welfare check at Starbucks. All clear. Patrol down Queen Street with visible presence.
Arrived at Queen Street / Wyndham Street. Checked. All clear.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a street vagrant sleeping in front of the store; staff requested assistance ahead of a scheduled audit.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. Guards asked the POI to move along politely; he moved to the side away from McDonald's property but refused to leave completely as he was on public space. Presence maintained.
Welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and Mid City Shopping Centre. All clear.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee. No issues.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full walkthrough completed. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no concerns requiring assistance.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments. Welfare check inside Atrium on Elliott heading towards Crowne Plaza Hotel. All clear.
Welfare checks at Mr Barber, City Convenience Store, and AA Insurance. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. A few street persons around Victoria / Federal Street but no complaints raised. Welfare checks on area stores. Presence maintained.
Welfare checks along Kingston Street, including The People's Barista, Pizza Hut, and Convenience Store. All clear.
Arrived at Kingston Street / Albert Street. Welfare check at Little Albert's Cafe. All clear.
Arrived at Albert Street / Wyndham Street. Welfare checks at Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Cafe. All clear.
Walkthrough around Cathedral Church and Federal Square. No issues.
Welfare checks at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at Customs Street / Albert Street intersection. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Welfare checks at Metro Woolworths and Aotea Gifts. All clear.
Welfare check at OK Gift Shop. All clear.
Arrived at Queens Wharf. Full walkthrough to check for vagrants/encampments. All clear.
Returned to Commercial Bay. Full sweep with welfare checks on stores and cafes. All clear.
Patrol continued. Alpha Route ended and Echo Route commenced.
Welfare checks at Queens Arcade, St Pierre's Sushi, Tuck Shop, Movenpick, and Four Square. All clear.
Arrived at Kiwibank check-in. Scoped thoroughly. All clear.
Welfare checks at The Coffee Club, 77 Convenience Store, Mr Katsu, and Evans Kebabs. All clear.
Welfare checks at Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Liquor Store, Smiley Mart Convenience Store, Chargrill, Sienna Cafe, King Made Noodles, and others. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no visible issues.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark check-in. Full sweep with welfare checks on stores and static guards. All clear.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male individual who had been inside the bathroom too long; staff requested assistance.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. The POI came outside and realised his belongings were missing from the front; he became frustrated, yelled, and accused staff. CCTV review showed construction workers cleaning nearby had placed his items in the rubbish bin. Bodycam captured. Guards calmed the situation; the POI apologised and moved along, reminded bathrooms are for customer use only.
Guards left standby and continued patrol.
Response call from The Coffee Club, Wyndham Street, regarding a male sleeping inside and refusing to leave.
Arrived at The Coffee Club. Guards woke the POI and asked him to leave (customer-use only); POI complied. Bodycam captured.
Walkthrough along Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. No issues.
Arrived at Chancery Square check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Patrol continued due to no visible issues.
Welfare checks on area businesses. All clear.
Welfare checks commenced along Lorne Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street / Wellesley Street. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Welfare check at Auckland Library. All clear.
Welfare checks at Nando's, Munster Inn, and Queens Food Court. All clear.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive. No visible issues.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full walkthrough completed. No issues.
Arrived at Elliott Street Apartments. Welfare check inside Atrium on Elliott. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks on all area stores. All clear. Proceeded to HQ for lunch.
Arrived at HQ. Lunch break commenced while preparing for afternoon changeover.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:05 – 17:00)
items: Team 2 (Brent and Dan). Equipment: 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone, 1x Radio. Briefing: welfare checks for issues minor or major; visible presence in theft/problem areas; assist lost/needy members of the public.
Debrief with Team 1 completed. Team 2 commenced Echo Route.
Arrived at Darby Street check-in. Welfare checks at Mali Thai, Celine's, Pizza Club, Domino's, Lumi Cafe, and Tank. All clear.

Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks at Coffee Club, Woolworths, Belgar Barbers, City Liquor, Scrunchy Millers, AA Insurance, Sky Mart, JD Convenience, V Phix Mobiles, People's Barista, Subway, 77 Convenience, 101 Hair Salon, and Mr Tacos. All clear.
Arrived at St Patrick's Square check-in.
St Patrick's Square sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Wyndham Street. Welfare checks at Good To Go Convenience Store, QF Tavern, Shakespeare, Ibis Budget Hotel, and Chemist Warehouse. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Welfare checks along Queen Street. All clear.
Commercial Bay sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at Gore Street. Welfare checks commenced along Fort Street.
Arrived at Jean Batten Place. Welfare checks along Fort Street, Gore Street, and Commerce Street. All clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Square and Chancery Square. Welfare checks along High Street. All clear.
Chancery Square and Freyberg Square sweep completed. All clear. Echo Route ended.
Arrived at Queen Street / Victoria Street West, maintaining presence.
Arrived at bottom of Queen Street; stood by for nearby response calls while monitoring for vagrants.
Response call from Team 1 relaying Barfoot & Thompson request for presence at Wilson Carpark due to a suspicious group of vagrants.
Arrived at Barfoot & Thompson. Manager identified the vagrants involved. Guards stood by.
One male appeared under the influence of illegal substances. Guards spoke with him and conducted a welfare check after he was yelling. No issues to report.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Observed a male drinking alcohol in public and advised him public drinking is not allowed; he complied. Guards stood by.
Same male spotted drinking again. Guards advised him to put the alcohol away; he walked away. Guards stood by.
Arrived at Albert Street check-in. Welfare checks at Remarkable Gifts and Albert Mart. All clear.
St Patrick's Square sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street West. Presence maintained around area stores.
Returned to HQ for combined 20-minute interval and route exchange with Team 1. Team 1 took lower CBD, Team 2 took upper CBD.

Headed up Queen Street towards Aotea Square. Welfare checks at Nike, Cotton On, Mobile Planet, Daily Drip, Localito, Foot Locker, Bag Planet, Cosmetic Clinic, Avachi, Unichem, Fun Tech, Sale Shop, McDonald's Queen Street, ChaPanda, BBQ Chicken, Sal's Pizza, and Daiso. All clear. Presence maintained at Wellesley / Queen Street.
Aotea Square sweep completed. No issues. Stood by for nearby response calls.
Arrived at top of Mayoral Drive. Welfare check with train station guard. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Wellesley Street.
Arrived at Auckland Library; full sweep down to Lorne Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street / Victoria Street East. Full sweep completed. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Victoria Street East. Welfare checks at Puffing Kiwi, Sail City Mart, and Starbucks. All clear.
Arrived at Victoria Street West / Albert Street. Presence maintained.
Left standby. No issues. Continued routes.
Aotea Square sweep completed. No issues. Headed down Queen Street.
Arrived outside McDonald's Queen Street. Stood by for problematic issues or vagrants.
Headed down Queen Street towards Commercial Bay.
Suspicious female vagrant observed entering Mirrou. Guards stood by.
Female vagrant left the store and was verbally aggressive towards guards. Guards stood by.
Response call from Team 1 regarding a male being aggressive towards members of the public outside Chancery Square.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Manager of Square Bar identified the male vagrant; guards asked him to move along and he complied. Stood by.
Team 2 commenced patrols down to Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay sweep completed. Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street. All clear.
Arrived at Lower Albert Street. Welfare checks at Aotea Gifts and Woolworths. All clear.
Arrived at Albert Street. Welfare checks at Remarkable Gifts and Albert Mart. All clear.
Arrived at Albert Street / Victoria Street West. Headed to HQ for 30-minute break.
Team 2 shift concluded. Equipment returned: 1x Ops Phone, 2x Vests, 1x Radio.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Afternoon shift deployed. Guards stood by at HQ to recharge Ops phone, alert for response calls.
Arrived at Imperial Lane. Floor checks completed on ground level and Level 1. One vehicle parked inside; ownership unknown (photo on file).
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full walkthrough with welfare checks. All clear.
Welfare check at OK Gift Shop. All clear.
Welfare checks at Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths. All clear.
Arrived at Quay Street / Commerce Street. Scoped. Welfare checks at NZ Gift Station and 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Response call from Chancery Square regarding a male harassing members of the public and blocking people from entering the area. Second team (closer) notified.

Arrived at response location. Second team present and had spoken with the POI, known as Trevor, who complied with the request to move along. Guards stood by until he packed up his belongings. Auror post to be completed.
POI moved along with no further issues.
Welfare checks commenced on all High Street stores. All clear.
Arrived at Victoria Street / Lorne Street intersection. Welfare checks commenced. All clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street / Wellesley Street check-in. Scoped thoroughly for vagrants. All clear.
Welfare check inside Auckland Library. All clear.
Welfare checks inside Nando's, Munster Inn, and Queens Food Court. All clear.

Arrived at Aotea Square. Guards witnessed a female attempting to run from Daiso Japan staff. Guards intervened and assisted staff; supervisor stated she had taken items without purchasing. Police were contacted after the POI became non-compliant — yelling, screaming, and using racist slurs and profanity.
Police arrived and took over the matter. Guards continued patrols. Theft not yet confirmed; if confirmed, an Auror report will be completed.
Returned to HQ for the 09:00 team to conclude their shift. Welfare checks completed (all clear) at:
Second morning shift team concluded. Guards stood by for response calls while second team completed Auror reports.
Welfare checks inside Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check at Sky Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. Welfare checks on all area stores. All clear.
Welfare checks inside The People's Barista and Little Albert's Cafe. All clear.
Walkthrough around Cathedral Church and Federal Square. All clear. Returned to HQ for restroom break.
Arrived at HQ for restroom break.
Arrived at Queen Street / Wyndham Street. Welfare checks inside Chemist Warehouse and QF Tavern. All clear.
Arrived at Wyndham Street / Albert Street intersection. All clear.
Welfare checks at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at Customs Street / Albert Street intersection. Checked thoroughly. All clear.
Response call from Auckland Council regarding a male who possibly took a couple's red Lululemon bag containing a drone; POI heading up Queen Street.
Arrived at Peter Alexander and located the POI. Guards politely requested a bag check; POI complied and opened the bag. No items matching the reported missing property located.
Welfare checks on Elliott Street stores. All clear.
Welfare checks inside Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. All clear.
Returned to Queen Street and patrolled back down towards Britomart.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough completed. Also scoped Queens Wharf for public drinking. All clear.
Welfare check inside McDonald's Britomart. No issues.
Arrived at Customs Street / Commerce Street intersection. No issues.
Arrived at bottom of Fort Street check-in. Welfare checks at Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Smiley, Sienna Cafe, Chargrill, and others. All clear.
Continued patrol due to no activity.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark. Full sweep with store checks. All clear. Returned to HQ to recharge Ops phone.
Arrived at HQ. Ops phone charged while remaining available for response calls.
Community Group reported three suspicious individuals rolling a joint in front of BNZ Bank. Guards proceeded to make presence known.
Located the three individuals heading towards upper Queen Street. Guards followed at a distance to ensure no further issues.
Group had not caused any issues.
Welfare checks inside McDonald's Queen Street, Timezone, MidCity Shopping Centre, and 77 Convenience Store. All clear. Spoke with the static guard at MidCity.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Presence maintained due to heavy public presence.
Arrived at HQ. Stood by for response calls while preparing for night shift changeover.

items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Body Cameras, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Patrol commenced down Queen Street with welfare checks.
Welfare check at Q Convenience Store on Queen Street. All clear.
Full sweep around Commercial Bay and Britomart Station. All clear.
Route continued with patrol up Albert Street.
Welfare checks at Albert Mart and Japanese restaurant. All clear.
Welfare checks at Karaoke Bar and Sky Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Wellesley Street and Mayoral Drive checked. All clear.
Full sweep around Aotea Square. All clear.
Alpha Route completed. Floor checks commenced.
Call received from McDonald's Queen Street reporting a male under the influence interfering with store balloon decorations and requiring removal.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. The male had just left. Police arrived, were informed, located the male around the corner and arrested him.
Welfare checks at Victoria Street and top of High Street.
Full sweep around Freyberg Square and Chancery Square. All clear.
Patrol through O'Connell Street, bottom of High Street, Fort Street, and White Lady. All clear.
Welfare checks at Gore Street and Auckland Harbour Suites. All clear.
Delta Route — welfare checks at Britomart and Commercial Bay. All clear.
Welfare check at carpark next to Chemist Warehouse. All clear.
Upper Queen Street checked. All clear.
Welfare checks at Aotea Square and Mayoral Drive. All clear.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks at Customs Street and Custom Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks at Fort Lane, Fort Street, and Jo & Joe. All clear.
Welfare checks at High Street and High Street Supermarket. All clear.
Welfare checks at Chancery Square, Freyberg area, and upper High Street. All clear.
Welfare checks at Lorne Street and Auckland Library. All clear.
Charlie Route — welfare check at bottom of Hobson Street. All clear.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store at top of Victoria Street. All clear.
Call received from Metropolis Hotel guard requesting assistance to remove a male under the influence sleeping on the premises and refusing to leave.
Arrived at Metropolis Hotel. Male still sleeping in the garden area; guards woke him and asked him to move along. He complied without further issue.
Guards stood by in case the male returned.
Area checked, all clear. Charlie Route concluded.
Echo Route — check at Darby Street and Elliott Street. All clear.
Patrol up Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Patrol along Federal Street towards Wyndham Street. All clear.
Patrol down Wyndham Street towards Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare checks at Q Convenience Store and Custom Mart. All clear.
Patrol through Fort Lane, Fort Street, and bottom of High Street. All clear.
Welfare check at High Street Supermarket. All clear.
Full sweep around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square. All clear.
Call received from McDonald's Queen Street regarding three vagrants sitting inside the store and not purchasing anything.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. Three vagrants still sitting in the lobby; guards instructed them to move along and they complied and left without issue.
Returned to HQ for floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Handover to morning shift completed. Night shift concluded.

Serious / notable: Daiso Japan / Aotea Square suspected theft — non-compliant female, racist slurs, Police attended (16:25, photos/videos on file). McDonald's Queen Street intoxicated male arrested by Police (00:35). Possible stolen red Lululemon bag/drone — consensual bag check, nothing found (19:13). Chancery Square obstruction/harassment — POI Trevor moved on (15:37). Barfoot & Thompson / Wilson Carpark vagrant group (11:10). Commercial Bay public drinking (11:37/11:45). Mirrou suspicious female, verbally aggressive (15:32/15:35). Metropolis Hotel male under influence moved on (04:04). Imperial Lane unknown vehicle (15:09).
